selection.series_key: TARGET (UniProt accession) -- NOT the paper, unlike g1-g4

dedup: canonical SMILES pair, against the whole built v7 corpus (g1-g4)
sentence_rules: unchanged from g3/g4: v2 input-anchored + pocket envelope
note: These are same-series-like analogue pairs, NOT matched molecular pairs: no fragmentation, no single-transformation constraint.

tier_meaning.g6a_same_paper: both ligands appear together in at least one paper -- same series in the g1-g4 sense, so the two crystals are likely the same construct and numbering. LOWEST RISK: label these first.
tier_meaning.g6b_cross_paper: the two ligands never co-occur in a paper. Same UniProt target, but different studies -- different construct, crystal form and possibly residue numbering are all live risks. Flag rather than guess when numbering does not line up.
